statements.text: Government has noted that some employees with pending vigilance enquiries or disciplinary proceedings were transferred or relieved without the knowledge of the Vigilance wing, thereby hampering the enquiries.
statements.quote: It has been brought to the notice of the Government that in some cases employees against whom vigilance enquiries or disciplinary proceedings were pending were transferred or relieved without the knowledge of the Vigilance wing, thereby hampering the enquiries.

statements.text: All Departments are instructed that no employee against whom a vigilance enquiry or disciplinary proceeding is pending or contemplated shall be transferred or relieved without the prior clearance of the Vigilance section of the Department.
statements.quote: All Departments are therefore instructed that no employee against whom a vigilance enquiry or disciplinary proceeding is pending or contemplated shall be transferred or relieved without the prior clearance of the Vigilance section of the Department.

statements.text: Every note proposing the transfer of an employee shall specifically record the Vigilance clearance status.
statements.quote: Every note proposing the transfer of an employee shall specifically record the Vigilance clearance status.

statements.text: Under the Urban Services Department's Standing Order No.2/2020, the dealing assistant must verify and record the Vigilance clearance status in the transfer note.

statements.text: Under G.O.Ms.No.31, transfer requests of employees with pending or contemplated proceedings shall not be considered until their conclusion, and clearance of the Vigilance section is mandatory.
statements.quote: or contemplated shall not be considered until the conclusion of such proceedings. Clearance of the Vigilance section is mandatory, as per the reference 3rd read above.
